Choose the type of Checkpoint used. Disable the one your are not going to use.

Wan 2.2 uses a different diffusion model for the first steps (high noise) vs the last steps (low noise).

This Workflow is set to gguf by default.

Remember to attach the nodes after!

Preview of your final result video will be shown here.
If you don't where the results are going just cancel the run!
If you want to save the output change "save output" to true.

The last frame of you final result video will be shown here.
The image will be saved on the same folder as your video.
Still using the same as the wan 2.1
Shift is set to "8" by default.  Feel free to change it and test new configurations.

**Solo, unisex. The character slowly approaches the window, every footstep heavy with dread, knees trembling. Their hands shake violently as they grip the thick, dust-laden curtains, fingertips almost numb from tension. Each shallow, ragged breath pierces the silence, chest heaving as panic begins to rise.

With a trembling, desperate tug, the curtains part.

Instead of streets and sky, a suffocating void presses against the glass. From the darkness, a colossal demonic eye emerges—first a distorted blur, then horrifying detail. Its bloodshot veins glow like molten cracks, the iris swirling with fire-red and abyssal black. The jagged pupil snaps sharply into focus, locking onto the character, unblinking.

A scream rises in their throat, eyes wide, trembling lips parting in terror. Sweat pours down their face as they stagger backward, chest pounding. The floor seems to tilt beneath their feet, shadows crawling up the walls and twisting unnaturally. From the corners of the eye, thick black tar-like liquid begins to ooze, slithering over the glass, spreading across the floor, reaching toward the character.

Overwhelmed by fear, the character finally breaks—legs buckle, hands claw at doors, knobs, anything to escape. They sprint frantically, stumbling, sliding, nearly falling, hair and clothes whipping with every desperate movement. The camera locks on their panicked face, then cuts sharply between the unblinking demonic gaze and the chaotic escape.

The room itself seems alive, warping, twisting; shadows stretch, black liquid surges forward, as if the eye drags the very space toward its devouring stare. Every heartbeat, every ragged breath, every frantic glance amplifies the terror—the character is consumed by pure, visceral, overwhelming horror as they fight to flee, yet the darkness and the eye seem endless, pressing in from all sides.**

-Set youR seed, Steps and CFG

-Seed: If your are not having luck with your results, try changing the seed.

-Steps: More steps means better quality but longer generation time. Its set as "6" by default. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use even numbers! 

-CFG: More CFG means better results but lognger generation time. Its set as "1" by default. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use values between "1" and "1.5".
